\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{به} \fa{یاد} \fa{آوردن} (be yâd âvardan)}{به یاد آوردن (be yâd âvardan)}]{\fa{به} \fa{یاد} \fa{آوردن} (be yâd âvardan) — to remember}

\label{lesson:FA-C146-be-yad-avardan}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for to believe, then the Persian for to call.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{به} \fa{یاد} \fa{آوردن}}
\textbf{\fa{به} \fa{یاد} \fa{آوردن}} — \emph{be yâd âvardan} — \textquotedblleft{}to remember\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\emph{be yâd âvardan} is \textquotedblleft{}to bring to memory\textquotedblright{}: \emph{be}, \textquotedblleft{}to\textquotedblright{}, \emph{yâd}, \textquotedblleft{}memory\textquotedblright{} (usually traced to Middle Persian \emph{ayād}), and \emph{âvardan}, \textquotedblleft{}to bring\textquotedblright{}. All are native Persian. \emph{âvardan}, \textquotedblleft{}to bring\textquotedblright{}, is an inherited verb; it is usually traced to Middle Persian \emph{āwurdan}.
\end{cousinweb}

\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{حدس} \fa{زدن} (hads zadan)}{حدس زدن (hads zadan)}]{\fa{حدس} \fa{زدن} (hads zadan) — to guess}

\textbf{\fa{حدس} \fa{زدن}} — \emph{hads zadan} — \textquotedblleft{}to guess\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\emph{hads zadan} pairs \emph{hads}, borrowed from Arabic \emph{ḥads}, \textquotedblleft{}guessing, conjecture\textquotedblright{} (root \emph{ḥ-d-s}, Lane), with the Persian verb \emph{zadan}, \textquotedblleft{}to strike\textquotedblright{}. \emph{zadan}, \textquotedblleft{}to strike\textquotedblright{}, is an inherited verb; it is usually traced to Middle Persian \emph{zadan}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{cousinweb}
\emph{tarjih dâdan} pairs \emph{tarjih}, borrowed from Arabic \emph{tarjīḥ}, \textquotedblleft{}giving more weight, preferring\textquotedblright{} (root \emph{r-j-ḥ}, Lane), with the Persian verb \emph{dâdan}, \textquotedblleft{}to give\textquotedblright{}. \emph{dâdan}, \textquotedblleft{}to give\textquotedblright{}, is an inherited verb; EtymDB takes it back to the Indo-European root \emph{*deh\textsubscript{3}-}, \textquotedblleft{}to give\textquotedblright{}.
\end{cousinweb}
